args.body: Take existing TENDER-PREVIEW-REVIEW after checking its current status and claiming its actual lease. Independently inspect the complete six-file candidate, baseline, Python implementation and executed evidence. Reproduce digest a0dd85c35277519655338f6932d9a7ef613bef2ea1e1d2c5b11a138b90f23d6b and rerun parity/UI checks. Assess actual inline-script behavior, CSP compatibility, Web Crypto failure handling, UTF-8 size limits, safe rendering, numeric/canonical-hash limitations and the reported Python/JS Unicode differences; test a real browser if available and state its absence otherwise. Verify user-supplied data is never represented as authenticated official data, and preserve bilingual AI disclosure, hypothetical price, intake and expiry limits. Save/read independent evidence, record APPROVE or concrete NEEDS_WORK, and close with actual lease and lesson. Do not edit or deploy. December 7 expiry must cover the North Ayrshire datalist option as well as listing, offers and calendar; January 8 retirement covers preview.html. Synthetic execution is not customer use. Demand remains unknown and funding/revenue unverified.
